question: Kamal is at a distance of 10 m south-west of Laxmi. If Mohit is 10 m south-east of Laxmi, then Mohit is in which direction with respect to Kamal?
solution:
According to the given information directions are represented as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c6e8af9ca0af71735c4918b3b17086feee75964cf4121a5dad281fc05a36aa0.png]
